description: This file defines the PimReportData class, which implements report data handling for the PIM report in OrangeHRM. It manages report data generation and metadata retrieval based on search filter parameters.

classes.name: PimReportData
classes.description: A class to generate and retrieve report data and metadata for PIM reports, utilizing report generator services and search filter parameters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes PimReportData with specified search filter parameters.

methods.name: getReportGeneratorService
methods.description: Provides access to the ReportGeneratorService instance, instantiating it if necessary.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Returns normalized report data based on current filter parameters.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about the report, such as total data count, wrapped in a ParameterBag.
